findings.risk_policy_asymmetry: risk_policy.yaml treats stage 8 as high-risk and stage 10 as low-risk; specification SS6.10 defines both as the same 45% slope system, without distinguishing them -- the ASYMMETRY is specific to risk_policy.yaml and is NOT confirmed by the specification.
